derivation_disclosure: Frozen after r835 proved capture-timestamp rotation-vector bracketing and before build, capture or scene inspection. This audit replaces human labeling with a deterministic gravity-direction prediction and OpenCV scene-line comparison. Scene informativeness is reported separately from geometric pass/fail.

capture.pose_at_capture: quaternion SLERP between rotation-vector samples bracketing ImageInfo.timestamp
capture.display_image: ImageInfo clockwise rotation applied to raw RGBA frame

automatic_comparison.projection: r831 lens-pose composition plus r834 analysis geometry
automatic_comparison.line_detector: grayscale Gaussian blur, Canny 60/160, HoughLinesP threshold 35, minimum length 35px, maximum gap 12px

interpretation.informative_and_fail: coordinate, timing, lens pose or scene-line assumption requires diagnosis
interpretation.not_informative: no conclusion; acquire another automatic frame without changing thresholds
